# ADR 0001: Initial Architecture Decision

## Status

Accepted

## Context

This is the initial architecture decision record template. Use this as a starting point for documenting significant architectural decisions in the DevPulse platform.

## Decision

We will use Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document all significant architectural decisions. Each ADR will follow this template format.

## Consequences

### Positive

- Clear documentation of why decisions were made
- Historical record for new team members
- Explicit trade-off analysis

### Negative

- Additional documentation overhead
- Requires discipline to maintain

### Neutral

- ADRs are immutable once accepted (superseded, not edited)
- New decisions create new ADR files
